description: A dark, night-time oil painting of a medieval siege. An armoured soldier in chain mail and a kettle helmet, holding a long shield and a flaming torch, climbs a wooden ladder up a brick-and-stone castle wall. At the top, a man in a brown robe leans over the parapet with his arms reaching down. Below, other helmeted men in mail hold torches and a spear. Sparks drift through a smoky sky. A faint scribbled mark, possibly a painter's signature, sits in the bottom-right corner. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame.
